//===== OdinGuard Anti Cheat: aura unlocks ====================
//= Players earn auras; they are never sold. The catalog (name, effect, rarity, unlock) is og_aura in
//= conf/odinguard_athena.conf (generated by the OdinGuard Studio from modules/auras.toml).
//=
//= Sources:
//=  - quest:aura_t1 / quest:aura_t2  Aura Keeper in Prontera (quest log 64501 / 64502)
//=  - mvp:<n>          MVP kills of the account
//=  - bg_wins:<n>      battleground wins (BG_ranking, npc/battleground/bg_common.txt)
//=  - woe_castles:<n>  castles held by the player's guild at the end of WoE (online members)
//=  - event:<name>     event scripts call: callfunc "F_OG_Milestone","event","<name>";
//= Script commands: ogauraunlock, ogaurahas, ogauracheck, ogauralist$ (OdinGuard server module).
//==============================================================

// type$: mvp | bg_wins | woe_castles | event; for events the second argument is the event name
function	script	F_OG_Milestone	{
	.@type$ = getarg(0);
	if (.@type$ == "event")
		return ogauracheck("event:" + getarg(1));
	.@var$ = "#OG_MS_" + .@type$;
	setd .@var$, getd(.@var$) + 1;
	return ogauracheck(.@type$, getd(.@var$));
}

// battleground winners (called from BG_ranking with the team's member list in $@arenamembers)
function	script	F_OG_BG_Wins	{
	.@orig = playerattached();
	copyarray .@m[0], $@arenamembers[0], getarraysize($@arenamembers);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@m); .@i++) {
		if (!isloggedin(.@m[.@i])) continue;
		attachrid .@m[.@i];
		callfunc "F_OG_Milestone", "bg_wins";
	}
	if (.@orig) attachrid .@orig; else detachrid;
	return;
}

-	script	OG_Aura_Milestones	-1,{
OnNPCKillEvent:
	if (getmonsterinfo(killedrid, MOB_MVPEXP) > 0)
		callfunc "F_OG_Milestone", "mvp";
	// quest kills of the Aura Keeper: monsters of at most 15 levels below the player
	if ((checkquest(64501) == 1 || checkquest(64502) == 1) && getmonsterinfo(killedrid, MOB_LV) >= BaseLevel - 15)
		OG_AQ_KILLS++;
	end;

OnAgitEnd:
OnAgitEnd2:
	sleep 3000;
	setarray .@castles$[0], "prtg_cas01","prtg_cas02","prtg_cas03","prtg_cas04","prtg_cas05",
		"payg_cas01","payg_cas02","payg_cas03","payg_cas04","payg_cas05",
		"gefg_cas01","gefg_cas02","gefg_cas03","gefg_cas04","gefg_cas05",
		"aldeg_cas01","aldeg_cas02","aldeg_cas03","aldeg_cas04","aldeg_cas05",
		"schg_cas01","schg_cas02","schg_cas03","schg_cas04","schg_cas05",
		"arug_cas01","arug_cas02","arug_cas03","arug_cas04","arug_cas05";
	for (.@c = 0; .@c < getarraysize(.@castles$); .@c++) {
		.@gid = getcastledata(.@castles$[.@c], CD_GUILD_ID);
		if (!.@gid) continue;
		getguildmember .@gid, 2, .@aids;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < getarraysize(.@aids); .@i++) {
			if (!isloggedin(.@aids[.@i])) continue;
			attachrid .@aids[.@i];
			callfunc "F_OG_Milestone", "woe_castles";
			detachrid;
		}
		deletearray .@aids;
	}
	end;
}

prontera,160,192,4	script	Aura Keeper#og	4_F_SKULL06GIRL,{
	.@n$ = "[Aura Keeper]";
	mes .@n$;
	mes "Auras cannot be bought here, only earned.";
	mes "Hunt for me, win battlegrounds, hold castles after the War of Emperium or defeat MVPs.";
	next;
	switch (select("Wandering Light (common auras):Elemental Echo (uncommon auras):My auras and progress:Cancel")) {
	case 1:
		callsub S_Quest, 64501, "aura_t1", 300, 909, 50, 756, 5, 0, 0;
		break;
	case 2:
		// at least one common aura first
		if (!(ogaurahas("green") + ogaurahas("yellow") + ogaurahas("circle") + ogaurahas("violet"))) {
			mes .@n$;
			mes "First earn a common aura (Wandering Light).";
			close;
		}
		callsub S_Quest, 64502, "aura_t2", 1500, 603, 3, 984, 2, 985, 2;
		break;
	case 3:
		mes .@n$;
		mes "MVP kills: " + #OG_MS_mvp;
		mes "Battleground wins: " + #OG_MS_bg_wins;
		mes "Castles held after WoE: " + #OG_MS_woe_castles;
		mes "Use ^0000FF@aura^000000 to see and wear your auras.";
		close;
	}
	close;

// quest id, aura tier, kills, item1, amount1, item2, amount2, item3, amount3
S_Quest:
	.@q = getarg(0);
	.@tier$ = "quest:" + getarg(1);
	.@kills = getarg(2);
	.@list$ = ogauralist$(.@tier$);
	mes .@n$;
	if (.@list$ == "") {
		mes "You already own every aura of this kind.";
		close;
	}
	if (checkquest(.@q) == -1) {
		mes "Defeat " + .@kills + " monsters of your strength (at most 15 levels below you) and bring me:";
		for (.@i = 3; .@i < 9; .@i += 2)
			if (getarg(.@i)) mes "- " + getarg(.@i + 1) + "x " + getitemname(getarg(.@i));
		next;
		if (select("Accept:Not now") == 2) close;
		OG_AQ_KILLS = 0;
		setquest .@q;
		mes .@n$;
		mes "Come back when you are done.";
		close;
	}
	if (OG_AQ_KILLS < .@kills) {
		mes "Monsters defeated: " + OG_AQ_KILLS + " / " + .@kills + ".";
		next;
		if (select("Continue:Abandon the quest") == 2) {
			erasequest .@q;
			OG_AQ_KILLS = 0;
			mes .@n$;
			mes "The quest is cancelled. Nothing is lost but the kills.";
		}
		close;
	}
	for (.@i = 3; .@i < 9; .@i += 2) {
		if (getarg(.@i) && countitem(getarg(.@i)) < getarg(.@i + 1)) {
			mes "You still need " + getarg(.@i + 1) + "x " + getitemname(getarg(.@i)) + ".";
			close;
		}
	}
	mes "Choose your aura:";
	next;
	.@pick = select(.@list$) - 1;
	explode(.@names$, .@list$, ":");
	for (.@i = 3; .@i < 9; .@i += 2)
		if (getarg(.@i)) delitem getarg(.@i), getarg(.@i + 1);
	completequest .@q;
	erasequest .@q;          // repeatable for the next aura of the tier
	OG_AQ_KILLS = 0;
	ogauraunlock .@names$[.@pick], .@tier$;
	mes .@n$;
	mes "The light of ^0000FF" + .@names$[.@pick] + "^000000 is yours. Wear it with @aura " + .@names$[.@pick] + ".";
	close;
}
